main_text.l: Valentia in disp. 9. Tomi IV. in ter-
tiam Thomæ, docens multos ex Patri-
rem tamen appellat Medina in istis Pa-
ria illa dogmata refutavit. De hoc ite-
risdictionis simul, ut hodie pontificii do-
de quia Epiphanius tam prolixè diffe-
asserit, sit certè hic error Epiphanio
est de iure divino, non ecclesiastico,

page.notes: Catchword "debc-" printed at lower right; marginal ornament not transcribed. Some words in the scan are faint and read with reasonable confidence; the italic phrase "ratione ordinis & jurisdictionis simul" is set in italic type.
